I've played over 190 hours of this game, and I'm pretty sure it's not meant to be played that much. I probably love it more than the average person - the actual game-play style is fun, re-playable (at least for me), and scratches that rogue-like itch, as each "run" is unpredictable. I've passed the view limit and I still play it to catch rare monsters. I've recommended it to my friend group, streamed it, and even mentioned it at work. It's definitely worth the money, even if you only play it once or twice! I do wish there was more support for the game, but it's still perfect for what it is - and for what it was meant to be. 10/10!

This isn’t a horror game, it’s a group project simulator with higher stakes. We went in for content, came out as content. The game taught me how quickly my friends will abandon me for likes. The real monster was our terrible camera work. I screamed, died, and still got demonetized. Nothing bonds friends like collectively leaving the slowest one behind to get eaten alive while filming the whole thing. It’s not about survival, it’s about going viral. The monster didn’t kill me, my friend’s bad jump did. We’re not ghost hunters, we’re unpaid interns for YouTube risking our lives for absolutely no reason. We died horribly, but at least chat clipped it.

I don't recommend this game YET. It was very fun with 3 friends, but on stage 2 we would consistently lose all sound from the game. This included the recording when we would watch it after. It took almost all of the joy out of it at that point. Not everyone would lose sound, only people close together whenever whatever glitch would happen. Our one person who got lost had sound, and when hen picked the camera up, even the recording had sound back at that part of the footage. Really hoping this wasn't an April Fool's joke that will be left at it's current state. There is so much potential here and it'd be ashamed for someone else to take this incomplete project, revamp it with fixes and updates, and then overshadow it's predecessor under a new title.
